name: EBAY-OAUTH-REFRESH

parameters.query: SELECT refresh_token FROM oauth_tokens WHERE provider = 'ebay' AND environment = 'production' LIMIT 1;

UPDATE oauth_tokens SET access_token = $1, token_type = COALESCE($2, 'Bearer'), expires_at = NOW() + ($3::int * INTERVAL '1 second'), refreshed_at = NOW(), last_refresh_status = 'ok', last_refresh_error = NULL WHERE provider = 'ebay' AND environment = 'production' RETURNING token_id, expires_at;

INSERT INTO data_import_log (source_id, workflow_name, run_started_at, run_finished_at, status, rows_updated, response_summary) VALUES ('SRC-001', 'EBAY-OAUTH-REFRESH', NOW() - INTERVAL '2 seconds', NOW(), 'success', 1, jsonb_build_object('expires_at', $1::text));

UPDATE oauth_tokens SET last_refresh_status = 'failed', last_refresh_error = $1 WHERE provider = 'ebay' AND environment = 'production'; INSERT INTO data_import_log (source_id, workflow_name, run_started_at, run_finished_at, status, rows_error, error_message) VALUES ('SRC-001', 'EBAY-OAUTH-REFRESH', NOW() - INTERVAL '2 seconds', NOW(), 'failed', 1, $1);

_README: Import via n8n UI > Workflows > Import. Wire two credentials before activating: (1) Postgres 'eventhorizon' on the LA hub; (2) HTTP Header Auth 'eBay client_id:client_secret (Basic)' with header name 'Authorization' and value 'Basic <base64(client_id:client_secret)>'. Seed oauth_tokens with current refresh_token before first run: INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (provider, environment, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at) VALUES ('ebay','production','<current_access>','<current_refresh>', NOW() + INTERVAL '90 minutes'). EBAY-CARD-INGEST should be updated to SELECT access_token FROM oauth_tokens WHERE provider='ebay' on each tick.
